capabilities: insert timestamped log entries through a modal
autocomplete locations from a locations file
suggest note text from previous entries
write locations as tags or wikilinks
auto-append unknown locations to the locations file
disambiguation: Not a survey/questionnaire builder; it logs timestamped field observations with location tags.
extras: Locations default to Obsidian tags so entries are findable via search, tag pane, or Dataview queries.
motivation: The README says it is for fast event logging while out on survey tasks, capturing entries in seconds via hotkey or mobile tap.
problem: Recording timestamped field observations during survey work takes multiple steps in a normal note, slowing capture to seconds-level speed.
summary: Fast-logging plugin that inserts timestamped, location-tagged log entries into the active note via a keyboard-only modal with autocomplete.
